concept: Solving linear equations in one variable

scenes.narration: Every linear equation asks one question: what value of x makes both sides equal?

scenes.title: the question an equation asks

scenes.narration: Think of it as a balance scale, the left pan holds two x's and three units, the right pan holds eleven units, and both sides balance perfectly.

scenes.title: the balance scale

scenes.narration: To keep the balance, whatever we remove from one side, we must remove from the other. Subtract three from both sides, leaving two x equal to eight.

visual.payload: <svg viewBox="0 0 400 220"><rect width="400" height="220" fill="#0f172a" /><text x="200" y="190" font-size="14" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0">subtract 3 from both sides to keep balance<animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="0.2s" dur="0.8s" fill="freeze" /></text><text x="200" y="60" font-size="30" fill="#f8fafc" text-anchor="middle">2x + 3 = 11<animate attributeName="opacity" from="1" to="0.25" begin="1.6s" dur="0.8s" fill="freeze" /></text><text x="150" y="95" font-size="18" fill="#f87171" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0">-3<animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="0.6s" dur="0.5s" fill="freeze" /></text><text x="300" y="95" font-size="18" fill="#f87171" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0">-3<animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="0.6s" dur="0.5s" fill="freeze" /></text><text x="200" y="140" font-size="32" fill="#38bdf8" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0">2x = 8<animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="2.2s" dur="0.9s" fill="freeze" /></text></svg>

scenes.title: remove the same amount from both sides

scenes.narration: Now divide both sides equally into two parts. Each x turns out to be four.

scenes.title: share both sides equally

scenes.narration: Check by substituting x equals four back into the original equation: two times four is eight, plus three is eleven, exactly right.
